stages.futureGate: Only declared target consumer slots; strict later instant, at most one per kind per receiving original
stages.projectionOutput: Exact projectPriorConcern result from this actual TaskConcern; NoSelectedTask omits concern identity

join.directParent: Actual selected preparation or cue completion
join.expectedInput: Exact run/event/payload/target-original/instant/subject association checked before PRJ and content reads
join.consumption: One delivery per consumer; transactional once-only, no successful unresolved target
join.persistence: Independent complete-prefix replay and exact pending-queue equality; private map is not a save certificate

variant.scope: Current lane only in this first bounded feedback model
variant.selection: Same selection and allocation slots; replace downstream encoding/rank registrations, never execute both variants
variant.empty: Empty selected and unavailable cue still complete expected joins; no acquisition/memory read respectively
variant.disabled: Delivery checks remain active; disabled numeric modulation is a named model comparator
variant.body: No body feedback variant or shared body/event recall budget

work.deliveryCount: One per declared encoding/recall consumer slot, at most two per target original
